# anthropic_rbac_groups (Data Source)

Lists all Claude Enterprise RBAC groups in the organization (`/v1/organizations/rbac_groups`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) List of RBAC groups in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the group was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the RBAC group.
- `name` (String) Display name of the RBAC group.
- `role_ids` (Set of String) Set of RBAC role IDs assigned to this group.
- `source_type` (String) Provisioning source of the group (`api` or `scim`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the group was last updated.
